tasks.description: 1.1 `PR-F01` Implement secure credential-reference broker and official account workflows; verify callback validation, serialized refresh, reference-only worker propagation and synthetic secret redaction; document account prerequisites. Evidence: `tests/contracts/test_credentials.py`.

1.2 `PR-F02` Implement mandatory sensitivity/capability/aggregate-budget dispatch policy for native/proxy/auxiliary paths; verify no private leaks or paid fallback under retries/background extraction; document routes. Evidence: `tests/contracts/test_provider_policy.py`.

1.3 `PR-F03` Implement Nemotron/OpenRouter, supported Codex coding/inference and Claude eligibility adapters plus OmniRoute service policy; verify catalogs vs entitlement, 429/deadline/cancel and proxy loop fixtures; document provider differences. Evidence: `tests/contracts/test_providers.py`.

2.1 `PR-R0032` Implement `R0032` in `src/hermes_installer/policy.py`: Default to zero additional metered spending. Existing subscription access can be used through supported authentication. Any paid model, cloud browser, image generation, embedding, transcription, or other paid API must remain disabled until a budget and account are deliberately configured. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_policy.py` (EV-R0032): Recording dispatch fixture: assert exact destination/model/data classification and aggregate budget; deny paid/private-ineligible retry/fallback/extraction and preserve unavailable-route reason. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.2 `PR-R0068` Implement `R0068` in `src/hermes_installer/components/omniroute.py`: OmniRoute; omniroute: One routing service with deduplicated aliases; verify its ARM64 path and restrict configured providers/fallbacks. Verify with `tests/integrations/test_omniroute.py` (EV-R0068): Send synthetic tool-call route through service and recording endpoints; paid/private fallback/loop/compression/retry denial asserted; fixture and pending/live states remain separate. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.3 `PR-R0104` Implement `R0104` in `src/hermes_installer/evidence.py`: Requested remote model: Nemotron 3 Ultra Free. Research-time OpenRouter identifier: Verify with `tests/contracts/test_evidence.py` (EV-R0104): Evidence/coverage fixture asserts complete original scope and explicit platform/result/blocker, rejects skipped or configured-only success, and verifies redaction/provenance/commands. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.4 `PR-R0105` Implement `R0105` in `src/hermes_installer/policy.py`: nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free Verify with `tests/contracts/test_policy.py` (EV-R0105): Recording dispatch fixture: assert exact destination/model/data classification and aggregate budget; deny paid/private-ineligible retry/fallback/extraction and preserve unavailable-route reason. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.5 `PR-R0106` Implement `R0106` in `src/hermes_installer/policy.py`: Check the live model entry (https://openrouter.ai/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free), model catalog, supported parameters, context/output limits, token prices, account access, and rate limits during configuration. Perform an actual minimal inference and tool-calling test. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_policy.py` (EV-R0106): Recording dispatch fixture: assert exact destination/model/data classification and aggregate budget; deny paid/private-ineligible retry/fallback/extraction and preserve unavailable-route reason. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.6 `PR-R0107` Implement `R0107` in `src/hermes_installer/runtime/authorization.py`: Do not infer entitlement from a model appearing in a catalog or enforce unsupported parameters such as structured-output modes without checking them. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_authorization.py` (EV-R0107): Denial fixture at actual dispatch/process/filesystem boundary: attempts beyond authorized scope fail before target side effect, including schedule/webhook/delegated identities and fresh lookup failure. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.7 `PR-R0108` Implement `R0108` in `src/hermes_installer/policy.py`: Handle unavailable models, expired keys, 429 responses, `Retry-After`, timeouts, and cancellation with bounded retries and clear status. Configure an explicit fallback allowlist; never silently choose a paid model or remove the `:free` suffix. Limit provider use across all agents collectively. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_policy.py` (EV-R0108): Recording dispatch fixture: assert exact destination/model/data classification and aggregate budget; deny paid/private-ineligible retry/fallback/extraction and preserve unavailable-route reason. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.8 `PR-R0109` Implement `R0109` in `src/hermes_installer/policy.py`: The researched free endpoint excludes confidential/personal submissions and logs usage for specified provider purposes. Recheck these conditions and enforce compatible data routing. Private Google content, Home Assistant data, personal memory, private repositories, tool results, and extracted summaries must not be sent to an incompatible free route. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_policy.py` (EV-R0109): Recording dispatch fixture: assert exact destination/model/data classification and aggregate budget; deny paid/private-ineligible retry/fallback/extraction and preserve unavailable-route reason. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.9 `PR-R0110` Implement `R0110` in `src/hermes_installer/policy.py`: Apply this to system context, memory extraction, background work, retries, and fallbacks as well as the initial message. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_policy.py` (EV-R0110): Recording dispatch fixture: assert exact destination/model/data classification and aggregate budget; deny paid/private-ineligible retry/fallback/extraction and preserve unavailable-route reason. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.10 `PR-R0111` Implement `R0111` in `src/hermes_installer/policy.py`: Provide separate public/non-sensitive and private-capable execution configurations. Route private work only through a locally running model or another configured provider whose applicable terms and user settings permit it. If none is usable, show a specific unavailable route rather than leaking private context through a fallback. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_policy.py` (EV-R0111): Recording dispatch fixture: assert exact destination/model/data classification and aggregate budget; deny paid/private-ineligible retry/fallback/extraction and preserve unavailable-route reason. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.11 `PR-R0124` Implement `R0124` in `src/hermes_installer/evidence.py`: Connect my existing Codex access through supported OpenAI authentication (https://developers.openai.com/codex/auth) and the installed Hermes version's documented provider/integration mechanisms. Distinguish ChatGPT/Codex subscription sign-in from separately billed OpenAI API-key usage. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_evidence.py` (EV-R0124): Evidence/coverage fixture asserts complete original scope and explicit platform/result/blocker, rejects skipped or configured-only success, and verifies redaction/provenance/commands. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.12 `PR-R0125` Implement `R0125` in `src/hermes_installer/credentials.py`: Implement host-managed authentication, including an appropriate browser/device-code or headless workflow. Reuse supported credential references; do not copy reusable OAuth credentials into each profile, repository, container image, or agent workspace. Preserve refresh-token ownership and revocation behavior. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_credentials.py` (EV-R0125): Synthetic canary secret fixture: secure reference resolution, correct owner/scope, callback or refresh failure as applicable, no value in config/argv/log/report. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.13 `PR-R0126` Implement `R0126` in `src/hermes_installer/downloads.py`: Support Codex as a bounded coding tool for relevant profiles, and as an inference provider only through a documented supported integration. Do not invent a generic OpenAI-compatible API by replaying subscription tokens. Validate actual inference or a small coding task inside a temporary workspace; report authentication, entitlement, quota, and functional status separately. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_downloads.py` (EV-R0126): HTTP Range/digest and filesystem capacity fixtures: verify required capacity calculation, interrupted resume, mismatch/ENOSPC containment and preservation of prior generation. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.14 `PR-R0127` Implement `R0127` in `src/hermes_installer/evidence.py`: Retain my requested Claude Free account in the setup inventory, but do not promise that a consumer free login provides Claude Code, Anthropic API, or third-party inference access. Check current Anthropic authentication documentation (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication) and applicable third-party account rules. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_evidence.py` (EV-R0127): Evidence/coverage fixture asserts complete original scope and explicit platform/result/blocker, rejects skipped or configured-only success, and verifies redaction/provenance/commands. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.15 `PR-R0128` Implement `R0128` in `src/hermes_installer/evidence.py`: If the account is ineligible, mark automatic Claude inference unavailable and explain the supported account/API alternatives without purchasing anything. Continue installing the rest. Do not use cookie extraction, session scraping, identity spoofing, or an unofficial web-to-API bridge. Applications such as Jarvis or Banana with additional client/provider requirements need their own honest dependency status. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_evidence.py` (EV-R0128): Evidence/coverage fixture asserts complete original scope and explicit platform/result/blocker, rejects skipped or configured-only success, and verifies redaction/provenance/commands. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.16 `PR-R0129` Implement `R0129` in `src/hermes_installer/evidence.py`: Install/configure the verified OmniRoute component as the selected routing layer where its supported features help. Avoid stacking redundant gateways around native Hermes providers. If a direct provider connection is required, document that route while retaining OmniRoute's explicit component status. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_evidence.py` (EV-R0129): Evidence/coverage fixture asserts complete original scope and explicit platform/result/blocker, rejects skipped or configured-only success, and verifies redaction/provenance/commands. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.17 `PR-R0130` Implement `R0130` in `src/hermes_installer/policy.py`: Apply model allowlists, capability checks, privacy eligibility, aggregate budgets, bounded retries, health checks, and loop prevention through the actual dispatch path. Do not let a proxy's default fallback, compression feature, or advertised free-provider list override those requirements or corrupt tool calls. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_policy.py` (EV-R0130): Recording dispatch fixture: assert exact destination/model/data classification and aggregate budget; deny paid/private-ineligible retry/fallback/extraction and preserve unavailable-route reason. Update `docs/provider-routing.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.
